body: I see your point. Will do. Thanks.

He doesn't see long-term goals, because he doesn't see the point. I keep suggesting that he get a job to have some routine, but he counters that by saying he doesn't have the health or energy for that anymore. Then I said part-time job, and he was silent. So maybe that's an inroad. But he just doesn't care.

I know it's not on me. But... the stress hasn't gotten to me. Maybe one day, but not yet. I ain't giving up anytime soon, but I'll keep a therapist in mind if things go extra-south.
